title: Faryal FC Secures Crucial Victory in Karachi Elite League Derby
content: A masterful display by the squad at Faryal FC Ground secured a 3-1 win against Model Town FC, cementing the club's position atop the table with another commanding performance.
author: Faryal Media Desk

title: Youth Academy Trials Announced for Season 2026/27
content: Faryal FC is opening its doors to rising talent across Karachi. Free registration and trials will take place at Faryal FC Ground this upcoming weekend.
author: Faryal Media Desk

title: Ground Upgrade: New Floodlights and Pitch Resurfacing Complete
content: The club management is proud to announce the completion of modern LED floodlighting installation at Faryal FC Ground, ready to host evening fixtures.
author: Faryal Media Desk
